target_text: // store_row does not use index(): agreement ties the store to the index map.
body:
**[comments] Rule 5, a call-site comment says only why here: shorten**

The first sentence describes the callee's addressing (pair_base and pair_row_offsets in its body). One line keeps the premise and the reason this check matters.

Proposed:
```cpp
        // store_row does not use index(): agreement ties the store to the index map.
```
